**Research daily (2026-02-23)**

**Key signals (AI platforms)**
- OpenAI “Operator” is being reported as rolling out more broadly (Plus/Team), pushing autonomous web tasking further mainstream:  
  https://champaignmagazine.com/2026/02/22/ai-by-ai-weekly-top-5-february-16-22-2026/
- Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 is showing up in roundups as a meaningful agent/workflow update (computer-use + long-context beta mentioned):  
  https://champaignmagazine.com/2026/02/22/ai-by-ai-weekly-top-5-february-16-22-2026/
- Google Gemini 3.1 Pro preview is being positioned around agentic multi-step workflows:  
  https://jonathanberthold.com/blog/the-builders-ai-roundup-february-2026/

**OpenClaw / MCP ecosystem**
- MCP positioning keeps expanding into enterprise tooling. Concrete example: Google’s “Developer Knowledge API” plus an MCP Server (public preview):  
  https://developers.googleblog.com/introducing-the-developer-knowledge-api-and-mcp-server/
- More MCP-server announcements in ops/security tooling (example: Virtana MCP Server for full-stack visibility):  
  https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/02/19/virtana-mcp-server/

**Security note**
- The “Clinejection” incident is a strong reminder that agent-connected tooling can bridge untrusted text into CI / caching / publishing paths (prompt injection → pipeline poisoning → malicious publish):  
  https://snyk.io/blog/cline-supply-chain-attack-prompt-injection-github-actions/

**Recommended actions (practical)**
- Add a simple “tooling guardrail” checklist for OpenClaw skills: **never run package-manager commands (npm/pip/brew) based on model-supplied text**; require explicit confirmation and show the exact command first.
- Pin + audit dependencies: enforce lockfiles, prefer `npm ci`, and add a quick dependency-diff review step before upgrading any skill/tool deps—especially those with install scripts.

—  
Provider+Model: openai-codex/gpt-5.2
